title: docs: link hosted MCP sources
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Links each hosted MCP to its README or source directory.
- Expands the Pollinations MCP overview with its main capabilities.
- Keeps implementation and registry data unchanged.

Test: `npm test -- test/docs.test.ts` in `gen.pollinations.ai`

gist.headline: MCPs leave breadcrumbs
gist.blurb: The hosted MCP list now points back to where each little tool lives. The Pollinations MCP also got a clearer map of what it can do.
gist.summary: Updated the hosted MCP documentation with README or source-directory links for each server and expanded the Pollinations MCP capability overview.
gist.impact: Developers can now trace hosted MCPs to their source faster and understand the Pollinations MCP’s main tools without spelunking through the registry.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny librarian in a cozy garden workshop, pinning labeled trail signs from a glowing MCP directory to small README books and source-code planters. A cheerful CRT monitor robot follows the links with a map, while flowers and code vines make the documentation feel discoverable.
